reviews.comment: Truly a fun class overall. I had a great time in his class.

Easy professor, he just yaps the whole time. He does require attendance, but honestly, if you and a friend just alternate going, you can send each other attendance. Overall, easy class, super nice guy, and very understanding.

He and his TA Nikki are SO chill. A few late submissions were accepted, despite the syllabus. 4th and final quiz was online and open note. Got a 100 on the group project that was completed rather casually. Attendance is a grade! Not a sociology major whatsoever - decided to take SOCI 214 for my CD credit (cultural discourse) and paid off well.

Professor Harden had some of the most interesting and engaging lectures I've ever had in college. He really enjoys collaboration with others and constructive discussions. 5 tests throughout the class but all of which are online so it's super easy. Overall a pretty easy A in this class.
Professor Harden was great! He made class so interesting. He brought in a friend of his to tell their story about how they were wrongfully accused. It was a great class, but he did do attendance.

2 papers, 2 discussion posts, 2 exams, and one group project. I loved his class because he is really good at lecturing however he does talk a lot so beware. Him and his TA weren't that accessible outside class and his syllabus dates would change. Overall not a very organized course but he is an amazing professor and I highly recommend you take him.

I took Harden Spring 25. He was sweet and very understanding. There were a total of 8 grades: mid-term, final, (2) reflection essay, (2) discussion post, and a group project. None of his assignments were hard as long as you tried.
Good lecturer. If you are in to sports, take Dr. Harden! He is great at engaging the class. Course is also not difficult at all as long as you are willing to put in somewhat effort!
Dr. Harden is a great professor, and he genuinely cares about your success. This class is easy as long as you show up for class and put in a little effort.

I love, love, love this professor! He always started the day with new music genres, which got me in a good mood for his class. There is a lot of material in lectures, but it is rarely used on the "quizzes"(they are more discussion-based). There are 4 quizzes/exams online, open note, and open web. However, they rely heavily on textbooks. TAKE HIM!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Harden was truly such a great professor. I took him for social problems this semester and he made it super interesting. He always made space for thought-provoking discussions that really allowed the students to think about what we were learning. We had two papers, 4 online exams, and a group presentation. I would definitely recommend him!
Great professor who is very knowledgeable on what he teaches and a really genuine person.

I took Professor Harden's Sociology of African Americans class and I really enjoyed it. He is an awesome prof who really cares to hear from his students and really cares about the subject. He is funny and really listens to what his students have to say. If I could take the class again I would. 2 online tests, 1 paper, discussions and participation
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Harden was a great professor he gave good feedback for every assignment, and was willing to help you if you needed it. Most of the assignments are writing based so if you don't like writing theres probably a better option.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is my second time taking this prof and he truly is so awesome. The online class over the summer was a lighter courseload than my previous semester during the fall. He grades fairly, is understanding, and always get back with you. Best professor I've had at a&m he truly cares about his work and students. TAKE HIM!!

It is very important that you read the text thoroughly. I find that PowerPoints and discussions are not enough to get by in this class. Dr. Harden is super cool and loves to have discussions on the concepts. I find that his discussions are engaging, educational, and unbiased. He really challenges you to think and consider many points of view.

Dr. Harden provided clear grading criteria and was a fair grader. Our grade was comprised of four exams, two response papers, regular discussion posts, and one group presentation. Exams were challenging, but reasonable. His lectures weren't very interesting, but he did offer opportunities for thought-provoking in-class discussions.

I went into this knowing little about sports but the class overall is pretty easy. He is VERY passionate ab sports, and he always lectured with a smile on his face. The biggest challenge of this class was the group project at the end of the semester, it was hard getting others to collaborate. The quizzes are kinda hard too so look out for those.

Dr. Harden is an Amazing professor, he is understanding and has thought-provoking lectures. Also, he makes getting a good grade pretty easy. There's a big exam but it's completely open note and he tells you everything you need to know so it's an easy 100. If you have the chance you should take him!
